delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 3. CONSIDERATION. The receiving party agrees to protect disclosed information using at least the same degree of care that it uses to protect its own confidential information, for a period of three years. 4. TERM. This Agreement shall remain in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing or until all disclosed information ceases to be confidential, whichever occurs first. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
